note: Curated East Corner morning scan. Priority is current regional movement in capital, infrastructure and institutions; every item links to the originating source.

items.sourceHeadline: UAE defends the scale and character of its African investment
items.sourceDescription: Gulf capital is now large enough to sit alongside Chinese, Western and multilateral financing in national development choices across Africa, with direct implications for the Horn and East Africa.

items.sourceHeadline: Interest-free banking and Takaful forum convenes in Addis Ababa
items.sourceDescription: Regulators, bankers and finance practitioners are meeting in Addis Ababa around Islamic banking, Takaful, microfinance and financial inclusion, with National Bank of Ethiopia officials among the speakers.

items.sourceHeadline: Africa water and sanitation leadership symposium opens in Kigali
items.sourceDescription: The Kigali gathering puts financial credibility and investable water and sanitation systems at the centre of infrastructure reform, bringing political, fiscal, financial and technical leadership into one room.

items.sourceHeadline: Kenya plans a wider sovereign borrowing mix
items.sourceDescription: Kenya is considering panda, Samurai, Sukuk, diaspora and Eurobond issuance while managing a heavy debt-service burden, widening the financing menu while also widening exposure to external conditions.

items.sourceHeadline: Ethiopia begins $12.5 billion construction of Africa's biggest airport
items.sourceDescription: The Bishoftu airport project moves into its major construction phase in August 2026, tying Ethiopian Airlines growth to one of the continent's largest infrastructure financing programmes.

items.sourceHeadline: Regional financial integration gets a $9 million implementation layer
items.sourceDescription: The East Africa and Horn capital-markets and payment-systems project spans nine countries and targets cross-border investment, market infrastructure and regional financial integration.
